title: Reset a dconf key to default
summary: Revert a specific configuration key in the dconf database back to its default value.

steps.explain: Reset a specific dconf key to its default value. Replace <KEY_PATH> with the key path.

placeholders.name: KEY_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path to the dconf key

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for a reset. You must manually write the previous value back using dconf write.

placeholders.name: KEY_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path to the dconf key

warnings: This removes the custom value. Ensure you know the previous value if you need to restore it.
